rows.note: Show all imports every listed path into the allowlist in one batch (Rust restores the previous list on a mid-way failure) and the catch restores the previous allowlist when the authoritative refresh fails.
Suppression merges the hidden paths into the inbox baseline and writes the stamp in the same catalog write as discovery-suppressed; a failed refresh rolls the catalog half back.
